{{Top}}
[[File:Vibroknife-TNR.jpg|thumb|250px|A vibroknife]]
{{Quote|Last call I had was a bad one; guy pulled a vibroknife out, started slashing... it was bad...|A police officer|<ref name="SWG:AED">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>}}
A '''vibroknife''', or '''vibro-knife''', was a blade that used an internal generator to make the blade vibrate. These vibrations could make even a glancing blow into a huge, gruesome slash, thus making it a far more effective weapon in close combat, or as a tool. These small weapons were openly used by all denizens of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], from [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone]] [[Clone commando/Legends|commandos]] to regular citizens.

A vibroknife was the primary weapon of choice of the [[Imperial Agent]] [[Cipher Nine]].

{{Weapon-stub}}
==Behind the scenes==
According to ''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]'', [[Jerec (Inquisitor)|Jerec]] beheaded [[Morgan Katarn]] with a virboknife, although this conflicts with earlier sources where he used other weapons.
